methodologyNotes: Re-verified against official pricing pages via WebFetch (beautiful.ai/pricing-plans, beautiful.ai/pricing, beautiful.ai/enterprise, decktopus.com/pricing, plusai.com/pricing, plusai.com/security, slidesai.io/pricing, presentations.ai/pricing, pitch.com/pricing/usd). Gamma's official pricing page (gamma.app/pricing) returns HTTP 403 to automated fetch (real page, anti-bot protection); Gamma figures triangulated across multiple aggregators (costbench.com, checkthat.ai, flowith.io) — only the monthly rates corroborated by the majority were used ($10/$20/$100 monthly for Plus/Pro/Ultra), rejecting aggregators that conflated annual-equivalent with monthly. Tome excluded: Tome Slides was sunset 2025-04-30, founders pivoted to the Lightfield CRM and the brand was acquired by AngelList. Pitch USD prices fetched from pitch.com/pricing/usd. All prices reflect self-serve published rates; enterprise/custom tiers carry monthlyUsd null. Compliance flags set true only where stated on the vendor's own pages; otherwise null. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Gamma
vendors.provenance: Official gamma.app/pricing returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch (real, anti-bot). Monthly prices triangulated across costbench.com, checkthat.ai, and flowith.io; $10/$20/$100 monthly (Plus/Pro/Ultra) corroborated by the majority. SOC 2 Type II and GDPR indicated via trust.gamma.app and gamma.app/dpa; HIPAA explicitly excluded per gamma.app/dpa (customers must not submit PHI).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 400 one-time AI credits that never refresh. Gamma branding on all outputs. Up to 10 cards per prompt.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: 1,000 AI credits/month (rollover up to 2,000). $8/seat/month when billed annually (20% off). Removes Gamma branding. Up to 20 cards per prompt.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 4,000 AI credits/month (rollover up to 8,000). $15/seat/month when billed annually (25% off). Premium AI models, custom branding, analytics, API access, custom domains. Up to 60 cards per prompt.

plans.name: Ultra
plans.notes: 20,000 AI credits/month (rollover up to 40,000). Most advanced AI image models, Studio Mode, custom domains. Up to 75 cards per prompt. Annual rate not consistently published across sources; monthly-only rate listed.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: 6,000 AI credits/seat/month. Minimum 2 seats. Billed annually at $240/seat/year ($20/seat/month equivalent). Custom company theme, shared folders, admin controls, centralized billing.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: 10,000 AI credits/seat/month. Minimum 10 seats. Billed annually at $480/seat/year ($40/seat/month equivalent). Enterprise-grade controls.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: 100+ seat minimum. Custom pricing — contact sales.

limits: Free tier: 400 one-time credits, never refreshes
Plus: 1,000 credits/month, rollover cap 2,000
Pro: 4,000 credits/month, rollover cap 8,000

HIPAA-covered PHI explicitly prohibited per DPA
